name: Uralic
summary: A family of about forty languages spread thinly across the forest and tundra from Norway to the Taymyr Peninsula. It includes the national languages Finnish, Estonian and Hungarian, and many small languages of Russia such as Komi, Udmurt, Khanty, Mansi and Nenets. Its speakers lived for millennia beside Indo-Europeans, and loanwords from Indo-Iranian, Baltic and Germanic are laid down in its vocabulary like growth rings.

sources.citation: Hammarström, Harald, Robert Forkel, Martin Haspelmath & Sebastian Bank. Glottolog: Uralic (ural1272).
